description: Ruda Śląska: Ewidencja dróg publicznych: zatoki autobusowe is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ruda Śląska. Zbiór danych obejmuje zatoki autobusowe na terenie gminy. Wykaz zawiera m.in. identyfikator wewnętrzny, numer drogi, przy której znajduje się dana zatoka, opcjonalnie także długość zatoki oraz powierzchnię zajmowaną przez zatokę. Coverage: Ruda Śląska. The publisher named on the listing is Ruda Śląska. Its keywords include klasa dróg, zatoki autobusowe, odśnieżanie, nawierzchnia, drogi, rodzaj drogi. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
